name: website-video
description: Remotion: Videos aus Code – Hero-Loops für Websites, Reels, Projekt-Showcases

scripts.render:hero: remotion render HeroLoop out/hero-loop.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=27 && remotion still HeroLoop out/hero-poster.jpg --frame=0 --image-format=jpeg
scripts.publish:hero: npm run render:hero && cp out/hero-loop.mp4 out/hero-poster.jpg ../starter/public/media/
scripts.render:can-stills: for f in yuzu hibiskus minze; do remotion still CanStill out/can-$f.png --props="{\"flavor\":\"$f\"}" --image-format=png --gl=swangle; done
